name: Apple M4 Ultra (Mac Studio, 2025)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Apple Mac Studio (2025) tech specs: '819GB/s memory bandwidth' for the M4 Ultra configuration. Unified pool, shared with CPU - not a dedicated VRAM bus. Bus width null: Apple publishes bandwidth only, never a bit-width for M-series; not back-computed.
notes: Largest M4-generation Apple Silicon part; two M4 Max dies fused. Up to 192 GB unified memory (some SKUs 256 GB). Aggregate siliconscore benchmarks file it as 'M4 Ultra (192 GB)'. Decode scales roughly with 819 GB/s.
